items.title: ARG — The Clockwork Puzzle (solved)
items.description: My notes and final answer for the Clockwork Puzzle ARG.
items.body:
**Final answer:** 31415

Steps taken:
1. Found the glyphs in the second chapter
2. Converted using the table from the forum
3. Combined to get the pi sequence

I keep my writeup and clues here so I can reference them during future ARGs.
